text:
/do-beads run 2026-05-12 hit the same design gap as JMAP-sc1b.17.4 — see that bead's comment for the full A/B/C analysis.

Summary for .17.5 specifically:
- `crate-jmap-chat-server/Cargo.toml` has NO axum/hyper dep. No `serve_axum` or `serve_ws` helper exists.
- `crate-jmap-chat-client/Cargo.toml` has only wiremock + tokio as dev-deps; no `jmap-chat-server` dev-dep.

SSE adds a further wrinkle: wiremock 0.6 does NOT support `text/event-stream` chunked responses natively. A faithful sse_listen.rs example needs either (a) a tiny hand-rolled tokio TcpListener serving one fixed `text/event-stream` body, or (b) a real SSE-capable server, which loops back to .17.4's options.

WebSocket adds an even bigger wrinkle: there's no wiremock-equivalent for tokio-tungstenite in jmap-chat-client's current dev-deps. A ws_loop.rs example would need tokio-tungstenite as a dev-dep AND a hand-rolled WS handshake server.

Recommendation: same as .17.4, option (A), but adapted:
  - sse_listen.rs: hand-rolled tokio TcpListener serving one `text/event-stream` block of synthetic StateChange frames (~120 LOC).
  - ws_loop.rs: hand-rolled tokio-tungstenite accept loop replying with one Response frame and one StateChange frame (~120 LOC; needs tokio-tungstenite added to dev-deps).

Both are realistic stand-ins for a "real chat server" without dragging in axum or jmap-chat-server.

If Mark prefers option (C) — add HTTP/SSE/WS bridges to jmap-chat-server — file a new sequel bead and link this as `depends-on`.

Drop the human label once a decision is locked in.
